recommendation.doNotAlphaTrim: Uploaded marks use consistent square canvases; trimming to alpha would greatly over-enlarge wide oval and bolt marks.

evidence.observation: SF and PIT marks deliberately fill the intro end panels and clip at the band top and bottom; logos move outward at a stable scale in the entrance, remain fixed in hold, and retain scale while the face masks clear in the exit.

At 02:54:00 with player dock and 04:06:00 with timeout, GB and DAL marks fill their scorebug wings and their contours are cropped by the existing wing boundary. Team marks retain the same scale with the attached graphic; the home mark is not mirrored.

reference.css intro logo has repeated contain!important overrides in a 425x246 box, including a rule whose comment says the logos fill and crop.

exitPendingAnalysis.mechanism: freezeFrame234 clones each IMG with cloneNode(false), inserts the copied stage, and diagnostics immediately reads complete/naturalWidth in the same synchronous task. New IMG clones may still be pending their own image-resource state even when the original preloaded resource is cached. The exit cover also swaps SVGsrc each animation frame; this snapshot clones that current URL. The report does not record original SVG complete state, so it cannot distinguish an original decode wait from this clone initialization timing.
exitPendingAnalysis.classification: These are exit-cover SVG snapshot flags, not failed team logos; no source change to exit cover or loading logic occurred.
exitPendingAnalysis.recommendedVerification: No source fix or broad rerun warranted. Verify the rendered frozen SVGs have finished loading after a browser turn, or rerun only scorebug OUT with clone image decoding settled before recording pending flags. Include the cleared tail at or beyond1700ms; the default electrical OUT lasts1667ms. Do not call the immediate flags definitively false without the settled check.

pendingExitSVGQualification: freezeFrame234 clones IMG nodes and diagnostics reads complete immediately in the same synchronous task. Pending00/18/30SVG or other scorebug-out219 URLs flag snapshot initialization timing, not failed team logos. Original SVG completeness was not captured; these flags are retained and not reclassified as verified decoded. Settled visual screenshots support review of visible exit frames.
